shop.title: Pick a shop

bosses.title: Guild Raid Bosses
bosses.content: Every guild raid boss. Pick one to see its stats, abilities, and encounter modifiers.

primes.title: Primes
primes.content: The prime enemies fought alongside each boss — browsable in their own right.

progression.title: Progression step
progression.content: Step through the boss's progression ladder to see how its stats scale.

primeModifiers.title: Prime modifiers
primeModifiers.content: For each prime fought alongside this boss, the modifiers that activate as its HP drops.

adjustedStats.title: Adjusted stats
adjustedStats.content: Pick an HP-lost point for each prime to see the boss's stats, abilities, and field enemies once those modifiers activate.

tabs.title: Guild Raid Boss views
tabs.content: Switch between season configurations, current Meta recommendations, and individual boss or prime details.

season.title: Choose a season
season.content: Choose the season configuration whose tiers and encounter sets you want to inspect.

seasonBoard.content: Tiers contain encounter sets. Select a boss or prime to inspect that exact fight.

seasonContent.title: Tier encounter sets
seasonContent.content: Review each tier and set, including its chest, Guild XP, encounters, and turn limit.

metaRecommendations.title: Meta recommendations
metaRecommendations.content: Compare the recommended and alternate hero lineups for each Guild Raid Boss.

metaFilter.title: Filter by Comp
metaFilter.content: Narrow the recommendations and Comp guidance to a specific team archetype.

metaGuidance.title: Comp guidance
metaGuidance.content: Expand a Comp to see its signature unit, core and flex heroes, and suitable Machines of War.
